opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Reimbursement of previously agreed research expenditure (funded from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A, apply to the Administrator) or researchers on proposals already approved/under contract (category B, discuss with the relevant Series Editor). Recipients need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Financial support (as reimbursement of agreed expenditure) for research undertaken in preparing publication proposals for submission to the Hakluyt Society, or for research towards completion of approved publication projects under contract, for volumes in the main Series III or in the Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel series. Supports the Society's objects of advancing education through publication of records of voyages, travels, naval expeditions and other geographical material.

opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Essay Prize

next_open_date.raw: 2027 (details to be announced later in the year)

amount.raw: First prize of £1250; second prize of £250 (prizes may be shared)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any registered graduate student at a higher education institution, or anyone awarded a graduate degree within the past three years (allowance for career breaks). Evidence of student status required.
opportunities.summary: Annual essay prize for original research essays (6,000-8,000 words) on any aspect of the history of travel, exploration and cultural encounter or their effects, in the tradition of the Hakluyt Society's work, from any humanities or social sciences discipline. Winners also receive a certificate, one-year Hakluyt Society membership and a copy of a Society volume. The 2026 competition closed on 1 March 2026; the 2027 competition is forthcoming with details to be announced later in the year.
